# The engine paths (the M0 plan, Labels): a PR that changes a file matching any line is an engine PR
# and needs the real-drawing check's status; any other PR gets it "not applicable" from main's copy of
# real-drawings-na.yml, which reads this file from main. The code hash (06a) follows the same list.
# One glob per line, matched against the whole path: `**` spans folders, `*` stays inside one.
# No braces. What the check executes: the engine harness (06b) and, since 21c, the product's job
# (`vextrus/takeoff/tasks/read_file.py` and `vextrus/takeoff/services/export.py`) with every `vextrus`
# module they import, at any depth, but `vextrus/settings/` (21c's test_job_imports.py), which the
# check's checkout carries beside these without it being an engine path (scripts/real_drawings/source.py's
# CHECKOUT_ALSO; the job starts Django on vextrus.settings.job, test_job_checkout.py):
engine/**
tools/acadsharp-dump/**
toolchain/**
uv.lock
pyproject.toml
.python-version
vextrus/__init__.py
vextrus/modules.py
vextrus/platform/**
vextrus/projects/**
vextrus/drawings/**
vextrus/takeoff/**
